main_reviewer: fresh agent, to be assigned after complete drafts
blind_phase: Solve every actual learner task from student.md and its visible teaching and support. Earlier accepted learner chapters and actual prior registers may be consulted. The initial allowlist contains the learner master, earlier accepted learner materials/registers, and original primary page images only. Do not open current coverage analysis, audits, proposals, annotated source token maps, key, ordered models, private output sequences, full translation witnesses, or helpers deriving them. Some audit token maps contain referent answers even when their filenames are not marked private.
freeze_gate: Coordinator exports Beads and saves the independent solutions with actual learner/contract identities in a local Git checkpoint. Only then does coordinator explicitly unlock key and private files.
comparison_phase: Compare every solution with the separate key, all requested output positions, target/validity distinctions, source evidence and exact assigned IDs. Keep initial solutions immutable; record corrections and disagreements in separate review files.
paradigm_reviewer: Separate fresh non-author agent; verify actual complete displays and derivations against primary evidence, with every logical cell accounted for.
exclusive_files: Each reviewer owns only their allocated review files; no reviewer silently edits a lesson, key, contract, source audit or register.
known_exposure: No main reviewer has yet been assigned. Root and the three audit/design workers are not eligible to claim fresh blind independence from materials they prepared or inspected.
page_review: Every final learner and key page must have non-author visual inspection bound to exact final PDF and rendered-page hashes. A page ledger does not substitute for linguistic review.
